statusDetail: Rear Hitch pinout now has an iPhone trailer-light handoff for copying or sharing the selected connector function.
actionRequired: No action needed. Open Rear Hitch > Pinout to use the new trailer-light handoff.
summary: Added a Rear Hitch pinout trailer-light handoff with copy/share, search coverage, mobile bottom-bar routing, and browser-smoke verification.
impactReason: On iPhone, a failed trailer-light function can now be selected, copied, shared, and routed without scrolling the full pinout table.
